xbrli:xbrl.in-bse-shp:DisclosureOfNotesOnShareholdi:
1. Pursuant to the Securities and Exchange Board of India circular no. SEBI/HO/CFD/CFD-PoD-2/P/CIR/2025/35 dated March 20, 2025, the name of Pristine Logistics & Infraprojects Limited has been disclosed in the shareholding pattern under the category of promoter group with Nil shareholding.
2. The Company has availed rupee term loan facility (Facility) from Aditya Birla Capital Limited and such other lenders as may be agreed (collectively, the Lenders). In connection with the Facility, Pristine Malwa Logistics Park Private Limited (Promoter) has created the pledge on 3,28,43,780 equity shares of the Company in favour of Catalyst Trusteeship Limited (Security Trustee) through the depository system. The Promoter has also executed the non-disposal undertaking (NDU) for 4,33,251 equity shares of the Company in favour of the Security Trustee. However, the creation of this NDU through the depository system was not required by the Lenders. Pursuant to the Securities and Exchange Board of India circular no. SEBI/HO/CFD/CFD-PoD-2/P/CIR/2025/35 dated March 20, 2025, the Company has disclosed 4,33,251 equity shares under NDU in the shareholding pattern for the quarter ended June 30, 2026.
